name: UIAble
summary: Open-source React component library and block set extending shadcn/ui with a vivid design system, copied into your codebase.
description: Components and page sections built with Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui architecture and Base UI primitives. Covers inputs, data display, feedback, navigation and surfaces (buttons, combobox, date picker, data table, charts, sidebar, dialogs …) plus pre-built blocks: auth pages, contact, CTA, e-commerce, 404/500, galleries, heroes, pricing, team, testimonials and more. All code is copied into your project; no lock-in.
contains: component sections: inputs, data display, feedback, navigation, surfaces, utils
blocks: auth pages, contact, CTA, e-commerce, 404/500, FAQ, feature, footer, gallery, hero, pricing, team, testimonial
navbar, process, statistics and widget blocks also included
copy-paste components, full code ownership, no lock-in
